description: This file contains repository classes for database operations in a sports telecast backend, including classes for users, profiles, matches, events, highlights, and a base repository. It defines methods for CRUD operations and data retrieval with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: Provides common database operations and enforces type checking for session.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations related to user data.

classes.name: UserProfileRepository
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations related to user profile data.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve match data with filtering, pagination, and related entities.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve event data with optional filtering.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve highlight data with filtering and related match info.

methods.name: create_user
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database.

methods.name: get_user_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: get_user_by_email
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their email.

methods.name: get_user_by_username
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their username.

methods.name: get_profile_by_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by user ID.

methods.name: get_profile_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by profile ID.

methods.name: get_matches
methods.description: Retrieves a list of matches with optional filtering.

methods.name: get_match_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a match by its ID with related data.

methods.name: get_upcoming_matches
methods.description: Retrieves upcoming matches within a specified number of days.

methods.name: get_matches_by_event_id
methods.description: Retrieves matches associated with a specific event.

methods.name: get_total_matches_count
methods.description: Returns total count of matches, optionally filtered by status.

methods.name: get_events
methods.description: Retrieves a list of events with optional filtering.

methods.name: get_event_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves an event by its ID, including related matches.

methods.name: get_highlights
methods.description: Retrieves a list of highlights with optional filtering.

methods.name: get_highlight_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a highlight by its ID, including related match.
